observations: Two car headlight assemblies are shown side by side on a tiled floor.
The headlights have a modern, angular design with clear lenses and internal reflectors.
The top headlight has a circular projector lens and a smaller rectangular LED section.
The bottom headlight has a similar design but with a different internal configuration, including a larger rectangular section.
Both units have black plastic housings and mounting brackets.
The top unit appears to be a left-side headlight (for right-hand drive vehicles), while the bottom unit is a right-side headlight.
No visible branding or model identifiers are readable on the headlights themselves.
The seller claims they are Mazda genuine parts, but no brand or model is visible in the photo.
The watermark 'PUREGOLD GLOBAL' is overlaid on the image, suggesting a reseller or distributor.

claims.claim: All Mazda genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used ones.
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers on the headlights to confirm they are Mazda parts. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlights may not be genuine Mazda parts, or may be from a different brand altogether.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the headlight housing or mounting bracket showing any brand markings, part numbers, or model identifiers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or non-genuine parts, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The headlights may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lenses, broken internal components).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens and internal reflectors to check for cracks, fogging, or broken parts.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged, reducing value.

risks.risk: The headlights may not fit the intended vehicle model or may be for a different year or trim.
risks.proof: A photo showing the part number or model code on the back of the headlight assembly, or a comparison with a known compatible vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown fitment, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the headlight housing or mounting bracket showing any brand or model identifiers.
Close-up photo of the lens and internal components to check for damage or cracks.
Photo showing the part number or model code on the back of the headlight assembly.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
